newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's OTE to acquire 20pct of Telecom Serbia.
newsitem.headline: Greece's OTE to acquire 20pct of Telecom Serbia.

text.p: Greece's telecoms company OTE is about to strike a deal for the acquisition of a 20 percent stake in Telecom Srbija, New Serbia's telecoms utility, along with Italian state telecoms holding company Stet .

"Stet and OTE are in the final stages of negotiations with Telecom Serbia and the Serbian government on the acquisition of 49 percent of Telecom Serbia. Stet and OTE would purchase 29 percent and 20 percent of the company's shares, respectively," OTE said.
Further details would be announced following agreement of terms, it said.

According to Beta news agency, the Serbian government, owner of 100 percent of Telecom Srbija, has agreed to most proposals from Stet, including the price, and was expected to sign the deal on Friday.
Stet would pay one billion marks in cash immediately after signing the deal, as well as 0.57 billion marks in two tranches by January 1, 1998. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
